detached house = a house that is not joined to another house
semi-detached house = a house joined to one other house by a shared wall
block of flats = a tall building with many apartments
cottage = a small house, often in the countryside
attic = the room or space under the roof
basement = a room below the ground floor
chimney = a pipe that takes smoke from a fire out of the house
fence = a barrier around a garden or field
gate = a door in a fence or wall that you can open
driveway = a short private road from the street to a house
wardrobe = a tall cupboard for hanging clothes
chest of drawers = a piece of furniture with drawers for clothes
sink = a bowl with taps where you wash things
tap = the control that water comes out of
dishwasher = a machine that washes plates and cups
central heating = a system that heats all the rooms from one place
neighbour = a person who lives next to you or nearby
outskirts = the areas at the edge of a town or city
city centre = the middle part of a city, with shops and offices
countryside = land that is not a town, with fields and villages
